name: qa-cycle
description: The QA cycle spine. Owns the per-item state file (state.md) under a subject's docs/reports/records/<subject>/qa/ in the target repo, and a PreToolUse gate that refuses any write to it the spec's transition table (docs/specs/qa-cycle-state-machine.md) does not permit from the item's current state. Human-only transitions require a matching verdict token minted by signoff. A SessionStart hook reports the current state of any item in flight.
